Container.Name: MagicMirror
Container.Overview: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform. It turns a display behind a two-way mirror, a wall tablet or simply a browser tab into a personal dashboard showing clock, calendar, weather, news and hundreds of community modules.[br][br]This template runs MagicMirror² in server-only mode, the correct mode for a headless Unraid server: the interface is served over HTTP and rendered in any browser or on a separate client device such as a Raspberry Pi. The electron scenario, which draws to a locally attached display, will not work on Unraid and is deliberately not offered.[br][br][b]No manual setup is required.[/b] The template starts the container as user 99:100 so it matches Unraid's appdata ownership, and the image writes a working config.js on first start that already listens on all interfaces. Install it, open the WebUI and MagicMirror² is running.[br][br][b]If the WebUI does not load, check your subnet.[/b] The default config.js permits 127.0.0.1, 192.168.0.0/16 and 172.0.0.0/8. Networks in the 10.x.x.x range are not covered. Edit ipWhitelist in /mnt/user/appdata/magicmirror/config/config.js, add your own range, and restart the container. Setting ipWhitelist to an empty list allows every address.[br][br]That same config.js is where you enable modules and change the layout. Third party modules are installed into the modules directory. See https://docs.magicmirror.builders and https://modules.magicmirror.builders.[br][br][b]Security note.[/b] MagicMirror² has no built-in authentication. Anyone who can reach the port sees your calendar and whatever else you configure. Keep it on a trusted network and do not forward the port. Use a VPN or an authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy for remote access.[br][br]The container image is built and maintained by Karsten Hassel at https://gitlab.com/khassel/magicmirror. This template provides only the Unraid packaging.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: magicmirror magic mirror smart mirror smartmirror dashboard kiosk wall display calendar weather news modules mm2
Container.Requires: No manual setup. The container is started as user 99:100 through Extra Parameters so that it can write to Unraid's appdata; do not remove that setting. MagicMirror² is unauthenticated, so keep it on a trusted LAN or behind a VPN or an authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy. On a 10.x.x.x network the default ipWhitelist in config.js has to be extended before the WebUI is reachable.
Container.Changes: Initial release of the Unraid Community Applications template. Runs MagicMirror² in server-only mode from karsten13/magicmirror:debian-server, with selectable wolfi-server and alpine variants and persistent appdata for configuration and modules. Verified on Unraid 7.3.2: the container starts as 99:100 and writes a usable config.js without any manual permission or configuration step.
Container.DefaultTagDescription: Debian 13 based, server-only mode. Recommended for Unraid: broadest module compatibility, and the only variant that ships /bin/bash for the container console.

Branch.TagDescription: Wolfi based, server-only mode. Smaller image with a reduced CVE surface. Ships only /bin/sh, so change the template's Console Shell Command from bash to sh before opening a console.

Alpine based, server-only mode. Smallest image, but some modules with native dependencies may fail to build. Ships only /bin/sh, so change the template's Console Shell Command from bash to sh before opening a console.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port used to open the MagicMirror² interface. It must match the port set in config.js. Keep this port limited to your trusted network and do not forward it.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent directory holding config.js and custom.css. A working config.js is created here on first start. Include this directory in backups.

Config.Name: Modules
Config.Description: Persistent directory holding third party modules. Include this directory in backups.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for logs and displayed times, for example Europe/Berlin. If left empty the container falls back to UTC and logs a warning.

Config.Name: Run mode
Config.Description: Run mode of the container. Keep this at server on Unraid. The electron mode requires a locally attached display and will not work on a headless server.

Config.Name: Show mouse cursor
Config.Description: Set to true to show the mouse cursor in the interface. Useful when MagicMirror² is displayed on a touchscreen or wall tablet.
